thread.title: Analyst cuts iPhone estimates just before Apple's earnings report

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Analyst cuts iPhone estimates just before Apple's earnings report
text: While Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.08% investors looked forward to fiscal second-quarter results due out after the close , with the shares rallying 1.2% in morning trade, Canaccord Genuity analyst Michael Walkley cut his iPhone estimates for the third quarter, citing a "greater anticipated inventory reduction." He lowered his June-quarter estimate to 34.5 million units from 39.4 million units, as he believes the $1,000 price point for the iPhone X has been a "greater deterrent for broad market appeal" in the mature North America market. As a result, he expects "lower near-term iPhone ASPs due to mix and lower unit sales due to clearing inventory ahead of new product launches" in September, Walkley wrote in a note to clients. In China, Walkley doesn't believe the iPhone X screen is big enough for the high-end segment of the market. Still, he reiterated his buy rating and $200 stock price target, as he expects increased share repurchases to partially offset the lowered iPhone units estimates. Apple's stock has eased 0.3% over the past three months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.07% has declined 8.7%.
